Good morning Tammy,

Apologies for the delayed response.

We have received your Emirates ID and will be happy to arrange the viewing for you today at 12:00 PM.

Please note that this will be a self-viewing. Kindly find the location details below:

Building: Viridian by Central Park
Location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/JUSoYrB9Y6wB3E6J6

Once you arrive at the property, please let us know, and we will provide you with the apartment number and further access details.

Thank you.
